newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel more upbeat but 128.50 area key.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel more upbeat but 128.50 area key.

text.p: June notionnel futures have scope for a renewed rally but they need to get back above the pivotal 128.50 area to signal that more downside price action is not on the cards, technical analysts said on Thursday.
Susan Rigg, technical analyst at Chart Analysis in London, said this price region represented the late March rally highs.
"We did manage to close above it yesterday but it has slipped back a little today," she said.
Rigg said the market had showed a "good dynamic" in the way it climbed off recent lows. "I do think it's got to clear this level (around 128.50), which it's got a good chance of doing."
If the market did make a foray to the upside, it would encounter plenty of supply in the 129-130 region, Rigg said.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, said the short-term outlook was better.

"The break through the upper limits of the downtrend channel, in line with the other European markest, has materialised to abort the threat of downside developing at least over the short term," he said in note to clients.
"The bullish position has been strengthened with yesterday's move through the recent 128.44 high and a fresh buy signal in stochastics." He noted retracement targets at 128.80 and 129.32.
